products.product_description: Sweetums 24% Sucrose Solution Preservative Free 15 mL cups VPSU15037288. Each box contains 288 cups. Product is aseptically packaged in 15 mL cups with foil lid. Each cup contains 15 mL of USP purified water, 24% sugar, citric acid (buffer). Cup is latex-free, DEHP-free, BPA-free. UPC 00814247020673. Store at room temperature. Product is only used in the hospital setting including the NICU and administered directly to tongue or buccal surface.
